final: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer AS c JOIN Employee AS e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_counts AS (SELECT City, customer_count, AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_average FROM rep_counts), kept AS (SELECT City, customer_count, city_average FROM city_counts WHERE customer_count > city_average) SELECT City, SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count - city_average) AS average_excess, AVG(1.0 * customer_count / (SELECT SUM(customer_count) FROM kept)) AS average_share FROM kept GROUP BY City
